title: New and imported cues default to clipLocal when uniquely covered
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: New SetCaptions/import/UI-add cue IDs that sit fully on a unique covering clip default to clipLocal and follow that host on MoveClips.
Cues in a gap or spanning a cut stay absolute. Existing IDs that are or are made absolute are not re-anchored.
Source anchors stay CAPTION_RICH_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; MP4 text burn-in stays CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; sidecar VTT is the export path.
Already-delivered insert-move leave-gap, explicit range close, includeLinks=false, MoveClips follow, and ripple/insert interval crop/split/shift stay unchanged.
Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, marker business, I-006, source caption anchors, or 1000 random NLE undo.
I-005 remains partial; I-010 remainingAcceptance unchanged; 87 counts stay 26/48/13/0; XD10 unchanged.
Previous 128/119/104/95/85/75/64/51/37/7/281 counts are not mixed in.
